Identities dedup within the account on (type, value), not on contact_id, so three outcomes are possible: 201 when a new row is created and linked to this contact, 200 when the value is already linked to this contact, and 409 when the value already belongs to a DIFFERENT contact in the account (no_auto_merge — the row is not relinked; the caller decides whether to merge contacts or use a different value). Re-adding a previously deleted value revives the same identity row (200), preserving any consent recorded against it.

Permissions - `contacts.write`. API keys - `manage`.

Re-adding a previously deleted identity revives it with its consent history preserved. Supports phone, email, external_id, and psid identity types.

data.current_description:
Soft-deletes an identity. The row is stamped deleted and stops appearing in the contact's identity list, but it is retained so any consent recorded against it — including opt-outs — is preserved and stays enforced. A later inbound message from the same value, or re-adding it via the upsert endpoint, revives the same identity row rather than creating a new one with an empty consent history. The contact's primary `phone`/`email` field is left unchanged. Deleting an already-deleted identity returns 404. Deleting the parent contact does remove its identities and their consent records.

Permissions - `contacts.write`. API keys - `manage`.
